item.tib: me ri dpa' bo gyad phur bka' ma'i mngon rtogs nyung 'dus
item.coloph: ces mo ri gyad phur gyi mngon rtogs nyung 'dus 'di ni/ spyang dbon g.yung drung bstan rgyal gyis/ sngar gyi mngon rtogs 'di rnams las nyung zhing tshig brjod pa zhig gyis shig gi bka' byung bas/ kho bo cag yi dam la 'dris zhen yod tshul yin kyang / don rtogs pa ma zad phyogs tsam go yang mi nus na/ brtsam bya la 'gal 'khrul yod par srid kyis/ des na mi 'chab nongs pa'i sems kyis mkhyen ldan bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med ma mchis pa rnams la mthol lo bshags so/ bzod par gsol/ tshangs pa'i dngos grub dam pa snang sems gnyis su med pa'i ngang la snang srid lha ru 'char gyur cig ces pa 'di ni sgrub la ba spyang sprul nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhes bya bas brtsams pa'o// mu tsug smar ro// u ya sa ma ya//
